Coram : R.V. RAVEENDRAN*, A.K. PATNAIK
ELECTRICITY ACT, 2003: c s. 67(2) rlw ss. 42(1) and 43(1) - Duty of distribution licensee to supply electricity on request - Supply of electricity to the house of appellant disconnected on the ground that the passage through which the electric line was taken belonged to respondents - Claim of - Held: The appellant has a statutory right to apply for and obtain supply of electricity from the distribution licensee and the latter has a corresponding statutory obligation to supply electricity to the appellant - Distribution licensee directed to find out an a/cernate way to supply E
Decision Date : 02-09-2011 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 7572/2011 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
